notes.title: Demo Update: -Full Controller Support-
notes.content:
Hello!

I have pushed an updated for the demo, which add full controller support, a few new weapons and several quality of life improvements.

Thank you for your feedback so far! I'm closely monitoring  the steam discussions and our discord for more feedback. 

Whats New:
-New gun: Toaster
-New gun: Rebound
-Full Controller Support
-Boss events now give the player iframes at the start
-Several interaction bugs with the teleporter and pause menu have been fixed.
-UI changes.

Let me know what you think!
-Wubs
